input.summary: Add affiliate assignment right for Customer and a reasonableness standard on consent
input.comment: [Playbook] We must be able to assign to affiliates without consent and any consent for other assignments should not be unreasonably withheld; the existing M&A carve-out is retained. Fallback: mutual right to assign to affiliates and successors on written notice.

ops.oldText: Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights or obligations hereunder, whether by operation of law or otherwise, without the prior written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights or obligations hereunder, whether by operation of law or otherwise, without the prior written consent of the other party, which shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed; provided that Corio may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, to any of its affiliates without such consent.

input.summary: Delete the transfer of Corio-created Developments to Commerce One where Vendor supports them
input.comment: [Playbook] We own what we create and pay for, so we have deleted the proviso that shifts ownership of Corio-created Developments to Commerce One merely because Commerce One supports them on an ongoing basis; Commerce One's pre-existing IP in the Software is unaffected. If ongoing support is the concern, we can instead grant Commerce One a licence to the supported Developments.
